Label: ABPm
ScientificExplanation: Average arterial pressure during a single cardiac cycle; reflects tissue perfusion pressure.

Label: CVD
ScientificExplanation: Pressure in the thoracic vena cava near the right atrium; estimates right-ventricular preload and overall fluid status.

Label: FiO2
ScientificExplanation: Percentage of oxygen in the delivered gas mixture; determines alveolar O₂ availability.

Label: Hf
ScientificExplanation: Beats per minute; mirrors autonomic tone, cardiac output, and physiologic stress.

Label: Mpeep
ScientificExplanation: Baseline airway pressure applied by the ventilator at end-expiration; prevents alveolar collapse and improves oxygenation.

Label: Temp
ScientificExplanation: Core body temperature in °C; key for detecting fever, infection, or hypothermia.

Label: BE
ScientificExplanation: Calculated surplus or deficit of buffer base in blood; a primary indicator of metabolic acid–base disorders.

Label: CI
ScientificExplanation: Cardiac output normalised to body-surface area; gauges adequacy of tissue perfusion.

Label: Glucose
ScientificExplanation: Serum glucose concentration; vital for energy metabolism and marker of metabolic control.

Label: CKMB
ScientificExplanation: Cardiac-specific isoenzyme released after myocardial injury; aids diagnosis of peri-operative infarction.
